item.title: 2026.10.26-beta
item.description:
## What's new
- Pausing a window drag at a screen edge now moves between workspaces: left and right edges scroll the workspace a column at a time, top and bottom switch to the workspace above or below, and the bottom edge offers a new workspace when the last one is occupied. Parked-window thumbnails drag the same way, and with coupled workspaces every display switches together. A quick pass through an edge does nothing, so dragging between displays is unchanged. (Pro) - Pressing the overview key mid-drag continues the drag inside the overview, so a window can be dropped on any workspace, on any display. (Pro) - Dragging a thumbnail past the edge of an overview row now scrolls that row while the pointer rests on the band. The row keeps its scrolled position after the drop and springs back otherwise. - Drop zones have a new pill style with an icon and a label naming the action ("New column", "Stack above", "Add as tab"), and the edge bands have bolder indicators that stand out against window borders. - The Pro pane in Settings now lists the drag features included with Pro.
## Fixes
- Releasing a drag away from every drop zone after an edge switch now moves the window onto the workspace in view, instead of leaving it behind on the workspace it came from.

item.title: 2026.10.26-beta
item.description:
## What's new
- Drag a parked window by its thumbnail's title band to pick up the real window and drop it straight onto a drop zone. - The trial-expired dialog is now an animated rundown of what the free tier removes, and its Continue button waits out a 10-second countdown before it can be clicked. - Text editing shortcuts (⌘C, ⌘V, ⌘X, ⌘Z, ⌘A) now work in Settings and setup-assistant text fields; previously only the right-click context menu did. - The Screen Recording button in the setup assistant reads "Request Access" instead of "Request…", which looked like truncated text.
## Fixes
- Drop zones during a window drag now appear without delay, including drags that cross from one display to another, which could previously leave the zone missing entirely. - A long drag no longer teleports the window off the pointer partway through. - Clicking or dragging a partially offscreen window no longer jumps the workspace view mid-gesture. - After dropping a window to the right of a column, the view no longer scrolls to it and then snaps back. - A window whose position took a moment to settle no longer gets repositioned over and over, which could steal focus for several seconds. - Fixed a rare case where the setup assistant's keybindings step could overwrite an existing config file, losing settings such as window rules.
Also includes internal improvements.

item.title: 2026.10.21-beta
item.description:
## What's new
- Settings got a full visual overhaul: every pane now shares one row and section layout, controls line up across tabs, text fields for rule names and regexes get more room, and locked or inactive settings share one dimmed look. - New Support section in Settings, with a "Copy support summary" action that puts the version, build and device ID on the clipboard, plus links to Discord, email and the docs. - The first-launch assistant is easier to follow: steps show plain-language statuses, and the Screen Recording permission now leads with what it is for, window previews in Overview, the switcher and tab hovers, and notes that captures stay in memory and are never saved or sent. - Deactivating a license key now asks for confirmation first.
## Fixes
- License activation failures are no longer silent: an invalid, refunded or device-limited key now shows an error message instead of appearing to do nothing. - Several settings displayed defaults the app never used, including the tab gap, the overview thumbnail toggle and the focus ring corner radius; the shown values now match the real ones. - Firefox windows relocated to avoid the mouse across displays no longer land mid-screen. - Moves issued over IPC now place windows correctly. - In the Binds tab, clicking a workspace group's title now expands it; previously only the small caret worked. - Pressing Record on a keybind no longer shifts the shortcut field sideways.
Also includes internal improvements.
